![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The `validateArtifactPathsAndLoads` function currently relies on checking `artifacts.length > 0` and `artifacts.every(...)` to validate `sourceArtifacts`. This does not explicitly verify that all expected roles (such as `amendment_boundary_artifact`, `post_attempt_ms_reveal_payload_schema`, etc.) are present in the array, which can lead to silent mismatches if some expected roles are completely missing. Additionally, `sourceArtifacts` is not filtered to exclude non-record entries before processing, and no explicit invalid-type diagnostic is recorded if it is present but is not an array.

To ensure the system fails closed gracefully, we should:
1. Filter out non-record entries from `sourceArtifacts`.
2. Explicitly verify that all expected roles are present and valid.
3. Record an explicit invalid-type diagnostic if `sourceArtifacts` is present but is not an array.

```javascript
function validateArtifactPathsAndLoads({ handoff, sourceArtifacts, errors }) {
  const requiredKeys = [
    'amendment_boundary_artifact',
    'post_attempt_ms_reveal_payload_schema',
    'all_3530_reveal_read_model',
    'question_to_ms_inventory',
    'page_asset_ref_manifest',
    'crop_candidate_manifest',
    'crop_quality_gate',
    'display_policy_artifact',
    'reveal_gate_artifact',
    'self_assessment_copilot_boundary_artifact',
    'fixture_directory',
    'fixture_manifest',
    'frontend_fixtures',
    'rehearsal_receipt',
  ];
  const pathsNamed = requiredKeys.every((key) => stringFrom(handoff?.artifact_paths?.[key]));

  const expectedRoles = [
    'amendment_boundary_artifact',
    'amendment_boundary_validator',
    'post_attempt_ms_reveal_payload_schema',
    'post_attempt_ms_reveal_payload_validator',
    'all_3530_reveal_read_model',
    'question_to_ms_inventory_validator',
    'page_asset_ref_manifest',
    'page_asset_ref_manifest_validator',
    'crop_candidate_manifest',
    'crop_candidate_manifest_validator',
    'crop_quality_gate',
    'crop_quality_gate_validator',
    'display_policy_artifact',
    'display_policy_validator',
    'reveal_gate_artifact',
    'reveal_gate_validator',
    'self_assessment_copilot_boundary_artifact',
    'self_assessment_copilot_boundary_validator',
    'frontend_fixtures',
    'fixture_manifest',
    'frontend_fixture_validator',
    'rehearsal_receipt',
    'rehearsal_validator'
  ];

  if (sourceArtifacts && !Array.isArray(sourceArtifacts)) {
    errors.push('source_artifacts_invalid_type');
  }

  const artifacts = arrayFrom(sourceArtifacts).filter(isRecord);
  const artifactMap = new Map(artifacts.map((item) => [item.role, item]));

  const allRolesPresentAndValid = expectedRoles.every((role) => {
    const item = artifactMap.get(role);
    return (
      item &&
      item.exists === true &&
      item.loaded === true &&
      /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(String(item.sha256 ?? ''))
    );
  });

  if (!pathsNamed) errors.push('required_artifact_paths_missing');
  if (!allRolesPresentAndValid) errors.push('source_artifacts_not_loaded');
  return pathsNamed && allRolesPresentAndValid;
}
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When validating lists of structured objects (such as artifacts), avoid relying solely on array length checks. Instead, explicitly validate that all expected roles or keys are present, and use defensive optional chaining to handle potentially null or malformed entries safely.
2. When validating expected array fields, if a field is present but has an invalid type, record an explicit invalid-type diagnostic and continue processing in a fail-closed manner.
</details>

+  ));

+  if (!artifactsLoaded) errors.push('source_artifacts_not_loaded');
+  return pathsNamed && artifactsLoaded;

+function validateArtifactPathsAndLoads({ handoff, sourceArtifacts, errors }) {

+    'post_attempt_ms_reveal_payload_schema',

+    'question_to_ms_inventory',
+    'page_asset_ref_manifest',
+    'crop_candidate_manifest',
+    'crop_quality_gate',
+    'display_policy_artifact',
+    'reveal_gate_artifact',
+    'self_assessment_copilot_boundary_artifact',
+    'fixture_directory',
+    'fixture_manifest',
+    'frontend_fixtures',
+    'rehearsal_receipt',
+  ];
+  const pathsNamed = requiredKeys.every((key) => stringFrom(handoff?.artifact_paths?.[key]));
+  const artifacts = arrayFrom(sourceArtifacts);
+  const artifactsLoaded = artifacts.length > 0 && artifacts.every((item) => (
+    item?.exists === true &&
+    item?.loaded === true &&
+    /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(String(item?.sha256 ?? ''))
+  ));
+  if (!pathsNamed) errors.push('required_artifact_paths_missing');
+  if (!artifactsLoaded) errors.push('source_artifacts_not_loaded');
+  return pathsNamed && artifactsLoaded;

+function validatePayloadSchemaContract(handoff, errors) {

+    handoff?.payload_contract?.ms_component_identity_path ===

+    handoff?.payload_contract?.ms_component_identity_required_for_rendering_or_debugging === true;
+  if (!valid) errors.push('payload_schema_contract_invalid');
+  return valid;
+}
+
+function validateFrontendHierarchy(handoff, errors) {
+  const states = arrayFrom(handoff?.frontend_ui_hierarchy?.states);
+  const ids = states.map((state) => state?.state_id);
+  const exactIds = sameArray(ids, REQUIRED_STATE_IDS);
+  const refsPresent = states.every((state) => arrayFrom(state?.fixture_refs).length > 0);
+  if (!exactIds) errors.push('required_frontend_ui_state_ids_missing');
+  if (!refsPresent) errors.push('frontend_ui_state_fixture_refs_missing');
+  return exactIds && refsPresent;
+}

+    item?.exists === true &&

+  }

+function validateBannedUiClaims(handoff, errors) {

+      'official_partnership_or_authorization_claim_not_forbidden',

+    }

+

+  let valid = true;
+  if (!hasAllValues(delivery?.delivery_mode, REQUIRED_ASSET_DELIVERY_MODES)) {
+    errors.push('delivery_mode_values_missing');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (delivery?.public_static_url_allowed !== false) {
+    errors.push('public_static_url_allowed_not_false');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (delivery?.requires_reveal_authorization !== true) {
+    errors.push('requires_reveal_authorization_not_true');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (delivery?.pre_attempt_fetch_allowed !== false) {
+    errors.push('pre_attempt_fetch_allowed_not_false');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (delivery?.preload_in_frontend_bundle_allowed !== false) {
+    errors.push('preload_in_frontend_bundle_allowed_not_false');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (delivery?.indexable_by_search_engines !== false) {
+    errors.push('indexable_by_search_engines_not_false');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (!hasAllValues(delivery?.response_cache_control, REQUIRED_RESPONSE_CACHE_CONTROL)) {
+    errors.push('response_cache_control_values_missing');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (!hasAllValues(delivery?.referrer_policy, REQUIRED_REFERRER_POLICY)) {
+    errors.push('referrer_policy_values_missing');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  if (!arrayFrom(handoff?.asset_delivery_notes)
+    .includes('preload_in_frontend_bundle_allowed = false')) {
+    errors.push('preload_in_frontend_bundle_allowed_false_note_missing');
+    valid = false;
+  }
+  return valid;
+}
+
+function validatePageExposurePolicy(handoff, errors) {
+  const policy = handoff?.page_exposure_and_document_policy;
+  const valid = policy?.page_level_reveal_can_expose_neighboring_answers === true &&
+    policy?.user_warning_required_when_page_exposure_risk_requires_user_warning === true &&
+    policy?.warning_flag_path ===
+      'PostAttemptMSRevealPayload.page_exposure_risk.requires_user_warning' &&
+    hasAllValues(policy?.document_only_default_modes, [
+      'unavailable',
+      'external_link_after_attempt',
+      'manual_review',
+    ]) &&
+    policy?.document_only_in_app_full_document_reveal_default === false;
+  if (!valid) errors.push('page_exposure_or_document_only_policy_invalid');
+  return valid;
+}
+
+function validateViewerAndBoundaryRules(handoff, errors) {
+  const rules = handoff?.viewer_and_boundary_rules;
+  const valid = rules?.teacher_admin_preview_reusable_for_student_payloads === false &&
+    rules?.student_self_assessment_can_raise_secure_or_exam_ready === false &&
+    rules?.copilot_selected_line_explanation_contract_only === true &&
+    rules?.copilot_selected_line_explanation_executes_in_this_issue === false;
+  if (!valid) errors.push('viewer_or_boundary_rules_invalid');
+  return valid;
+}
+
+function validateFixtureCoverage({
+  handoff,
+  frontendFixtures,
+  frontendFixtureManifest,
+  rehearsalReceipt,
+  errors,
+}) {
+  const coverage = handoff?.fixture_coverage;
+  const smokeChecklist = arrayFrom(handoff?.smoke_checklist);
+  const fixtureIds = arrayFrom(frontendFixtures?.fixtures).map((fixture) => fixture?.fixture_id);
+  const manifestIds = arrayFrom(frontendFixtureManifest?.fixture_manifest)
+    .map((entry) => entry?.fixture_id);
+  const fixturesCoverRequired = REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((id) => fixtureIds.includes(id));
+  const manifestCoversRequired = REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.every((id) => manifestIds.includes(id));
+  const valid = coverage?.fixture_manifest_path === handoff?.artifact_paths?.fixture_manifest &&
+    coverage?.fixture_count === REQUIRED_FIXTURE_IDS.length &&
+    fixturesCoverRequired &&
+    manifestCoversRequired &&
+    smokeChecklist.length >= 9 &&
+    rehearsalReceipt?.rehearsal_summary?.total_ms_reveal_payload_row_count === 3530 &&
+    rehearsalReceipt?.resource_access_receipt?.pre_attempt_payload_asset_exposure_count === 0;
+  if (!valid) errors.push('fixture_coverage_or_smoke_checklist_invalid');
+  return valid;
+}

+    rehearsalReceipt: inputs.rehearsalReceipt,
+  };
+}
+
+export function writePostAttemptMsSourceRevealFrontendHandoff(options = {}) {
+  const root = rootFromOptions(options);
+  const paths = pathsFromOptions(options);
+  const result = buildPostAttemptMsSourceRevealFrontendHandoff(options);
+  writeJson(root, paths.handoffOut, result.handoff);
+  writeJson(root, paths.validatorOut, result.validatorResult);
+  writeText(root, paths.readbackOut, result.readback);
+  return result;
+}
+
+const invokedAsCli = process.argv[1] &&
+  import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;
+
+if (invokedAsCli) {
+  const result = writePostAttemptMsSourceRevealFrontendHandoff();
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({
+    handoff: DEFAULT_PATHS.handoffOut,
+    validator: DEFAULT_PATHS.validatorOut,
+    readback: DEFAULT_PATHS.readbackOut,
+    validator_status: result.validatorResult.validator_status,
+  }, null, 2));
+}
